tree.heading: Administrator
tree.text: The term “Administrator” means the Administrator of the Agency.

tree.heading: Agency
tree.text: The term “Agency” means the United States Agency for International Development.

tree.heading: Appropriate congressional committees
tree.text: The term “appropriate congressional committees” means the Committee on Foreign Affairs of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Foreign Relations of the Senate.

tree.heading: Business development services
tree.text: The term “business development services” means support for the growth of micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises through training, technical assistance, marketing assistance, improved production technologies, and other related services.

tree.heading: Director
tree.text: The term “Director” means the Director of the office.

tree.heading: Implementing partner organization
tree.text: The term “implementing partner organization” means an entity eligible to receive assistance under this subpart which is—

children.text: a United States or an indigenous private voluntary organization;
a United States or an indigenous credit union;
a United States or an indigenous cooperative organization;
an indigenous governmental or nongovernmental organization;
a micro, small, or medium-sized enterprise institution;

tree.heading: Micro, small, and medium-sized enterprise institution
tree.text: The term “micro, small, and medium-sized enterprise institution” means an entity that provides services, including finance, training, or business development services, for micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises in foreign countries.

tree.heading: Financial intermediary
tree.text: The term “financial intermediary” means the entity that acts as the intermediary between parties in a financial transaction, such as a bank, credit union, investment fund, a village savings and loan group, or an institution that provides financial services to a micro, small, or medium-sized enterprise.

tree.heading: Office
tree.text: The term “office” means the office established under section 2211a(b)(1) of this title.

tree.heading: Practitioner institution
tree.text: The term “practitioner institution” means a not-for-profit entity, a financial intermediary, an information and communications technology firm with a mobile money platform, a village and savings loan group, or any other entity that provides financial or business development services authorized under section 252 that benefits micro, small, and medium-sized enterprise clients.

tree.heading: Private voluntary organization
tree.text: The term “private voluntary organization” means a not-for-profit entity that—

children.text: engages in and supports activities of an economic or social development or humanitarian nature for citizens in foreign countries; and
is incorporated as such under the laws of the United States, including any of its states, territories or the District of Columbia, or of a foreign country.

tree.heading: United States-supported financial intermediary
tree.text: The term “United States-supported financial intermediary” means a financial intermediary that has received funds made available under subchapter I of this chapter for fiscal year 1980 or any subsequent fiscal year.

tree.heading: Very poor
tree.text: The term “very poor” means those individuals—

children.text: living in the bottom 50 percent below the poverty line established by the national government of the country in which those individuals live; or

living below the international poverty line (as defined by the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the International Development Association (collectively referred to as the ‘World Bank’)).
